name: BD-AgroMet56
description: BD-AgroMet56 is a division-level time-series dataset that links crop statistics with meteorological records for Bangladesh from 1970 to 2025. It covers six major crops (Aus rice, Aman rice, Boro rice, Wheat, Potato and Jute) across the eight administrative divisions, giving 2,688 annual records and 22 variables. Each record combines crop production, cultivated area and yield with growing-season climate variables, including temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind speed, sunshine, solar radiation and evapotranspiration. Crop data were compiled from the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) and climate data from the Bangladesh Meteorological Department (BMD). Climate values come from one BMD station per division, so they represent station conditions rather than dense spatial coverage within a division. Crop records were harmonized to the current eight-division structure, and the data were checked for duplicates, missing values, non-positive values, temporal coverage and yield consistency. Some sunshine, evapotranspiration and solar radiation values are missing in the source and were left unaltered. The dataset supports analysis of long-term yield trends, division-level comparisons and relationships between climate and crop yield.
